prompt: A member saved all three meetings on a phone. Which update follows the correction?
promptZh: 一位成員把三次聚會都存進手機。怎麼更新才符合更正？

options.text: Move all three meetings to the hall; keep their start times.
options.zh: 把三次聚會都改到會堂，開始時間不變。
options.whyZh: 只有本週六移到會堂，後兩次依然在廣場。

options.text: Move just this Saturday’s meeting to the hall and keep its start time.
options.zh: 只把本週六的聚會改到會堂，開始時間不變。
options.whyZh: 本週六地點改了，但仍是十點開始；接下來兩次的地點不變。

options.text: Leave this Saturday’s meeting on the square and move the next two indoors.
options.zh: 本週六仍在廣場，後兩次改到室內。
options.whyZh: 公告只把本週六移到會堂，後兩次照舊在廣場。

options.text: Move just this Saturday’s meeting to the hall and change its start time too.
options.zh: 只把本週六的聚會改到會堂，也一併更改開始時間。
options.whyZh: 只有本週六地點變動，十點開始不變。

explanationZh: 本週六地點改了，但仍是十點開始；接下來兩次的地點不變。
evidence: This Saturday’s outdoor session is moving to the hall because the paving is being repaired. / We’ll still begin at ten. / The next two meetings are still on the square, so please don’t change the whole series if you saved it on your phone.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: This Saturday’s outdoor session is moving to the hall because the paving is being repaired.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The next two meetings are still on the square, so please don’t change the whole series if you saved it on your phone.

vocabulary.note: 此處不包含正在更正的星期六場次。
指行事曆裡的所有相關場次。
